title: TrustShell reputation event contracts, v1

why: GA's contract files were reported as committed on branch feat/ga-2026-08-17-contracts-v1 at 33cadf72.
That branch does not exist on origin (DealAppSeo/trinity-ecosystem, 31 heads enumerated),
the commit is not in this repository's object store, and no remote ref carries docs/contracts/.
Sean directed the implementation lane to author them rather than wait for another failed delivery.
derivation: Every numeric constant, formula and enum here is READ FROM docs/policy/authority-policy.v0.5.yaml
at blob 2b3374bb (branch xc/policy-lock, commit d88693b). None was invented.
Where the policy is silent, the field is marked x-unspecified rather than given a value —
inventing a number here would be the same defect as the hardcoded regulatory literals
x-provenance.lane_note: This crosses the XC/GA/CC lane split by explicit human instruction. It is a stand-in, and GA's authored version should replace it rather than merge with it. Provenance is recorded here so a later reader cannot mistake a stand-in for a lane deliverable.

lifecycle.emitted_when: a reputation-affecting outcome is observed and its evidence is present
not_emitted_when: last_active is NULL — skip, never invent a timestamp

IsoTimestamp.description: Observed, never synthesised. A NULL upstream timestamp must skip the event, not default.

did.description: Optional; no DID -> repid_agents.id mapping exists yet.

EvidenceRef.description: Without this an ECOSYSTEM_REFERRAL delta is 0 (referral.qualify_and.evidence_ref_present).

Axis.description: Five-axis Pi. Weights S 0.35, P 0.20, H 0.15, Q 0.10, E 0.20 (composite.weights); sum 1.0.

DORMANCY_DECAY.title: One decay tick within an open envelope
DORMANCY_DECAY.description: R_dec = max(R * (1-r)^W, F_tier), r = rho * m. Delta_full = R - R_dec, applied over K ticks. NEVER one-shot: reject.one_shot_apply_of_Delta_full_into_A_eff.

tick_K.description: K = min(8, max(1, ceil(W))). The prior K=4 applies ONLY when W is known-absent from docs, and never substitutes for inventing last_active (decay.K.prior_does_not_override_skip).

k_source.description: Which rule produced K. A prior must be visible, not silent.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per (agent, envelope, tick_k). Replaying a tick must be a no-op — promote.soft_live_to_live_write requires idempotent_ticks. This is the only defence against a decay run applied twice.

delta_k.description: This tick's magnitude. The last tick carries the remainder (decay.ticks.remainder_on_last).

delta_full.description: R - R_dec. INVARIANT: sum over k of delta_k equals delta_full exactly (decay.ticks.identity).

sigma.description: Envelope open. 1 while k <= K and settle is not done; 0 after the settle tick.

lambda_sigma.description: decay.lambda_sigma. Routing sees only lambda_sigma of the applied decay while sigma = 1.

r_route.description: R_pre - lambda_sigma * sum_{j<=k} delta_j. A_eff uses THIS, never r_ledger, while sigma = 1.

settle_tick.description: True on the tick where R_route <- R_ledger and sigma <- 0. Magnitude (1 - lambda_sigma) * delta_full; split into two equal settle ticks when that exceeds 50 RepID points.

dry_run.description: decay.write.dry_run_default is true; writing requires --apply or REPID_DECAY_APPLY=true.

x-invariants: A_eff uses R_route, never R_ledger, while sigma = 1
A_eff never rises because decay was latent
floor observe 'decays' do not enter R_route or A_eff
peer rho_rater uses R_pre, not R_ledger
a clustered DECAY is not collusion

ECOSYSTEM_REFERRAL.title: A qualified referral's reputation delta
ECOSYSTEM_REFERRAL.description: delta_raw(n) = 40 / (n + 1); delta = clip(round(delta_raw), 0, c(n)). Lands on axis Q, NOT S.

rank_n.description: QUALIFIED count only (referral.rank_n). A test_only referee does not increment n (mutant M5).

delta.description: Per-rank clamp c(n): 12 at n=1, 8 for n in [2,3], 5 for n>=4. Worked: n=1 -> 12, n=2 -> 8, n=3 -> 8, n=10 -> 4, n=100 -> 0.

lands_on_axis.description: Mutant M8. Landing this on S would double-count self-performance.

qualified.description: False forces delta 0. Requires ANY of qualify_or AND ALL of qualify_and.

proven.description: Unproven self-report is delta 0 even at n=1 (mutant M4, invariants.unproven_self_report_delta_is_0).

halo.description: DEFERRED. 0.15 * exp(-t/45d) on the outgoing peer edge only. Policy status.blocked lists referral_halo; it is not required to exit Phase 1, and emitting a value here would claim a mechanism that is parked.

x-mutants.M5_test_only_no_increment: test_only referee => n does not increment and delta = 0
x-mutants.M7_hal_clamp_untouched: the global HAL clamp remains +5; only this type uses c(n)
x-mutants.M8_lands_on_Q_not_S: delta lands on axis Q, not S

IMPACT_REWARD.title: Ecosystem impact delta
IMPACT_REWARD.description: I = clip[0,1](iota_sev * iota_who * iota_proof); delta_imp = round(delta_0 * (0.4 + 1.6 * I)).

contribution_type.description: Closed set (impact.types). Adding one is a cross-lane decision, not a code change.

iota_who.description: self_only 0.40, other_agents 0.80, people_ops 1.00, ecosystem 1.15 (then I is clipped to 1).

iota_proof.description: none 0 — which ZEROES the delta — artifact_ref 0.70, verified_bounty_or_contracted 1.00.

impact_I.description: Product of the three iotas, clipped to [0,1]. iota_who 1.15 is why the clip is load-bearing.

delta_0.description: The type's base delta before impact scaling.

delta_imp.description: round(delta_0 * (0.4 + 1.6 * I)). Global clamp +5 / -10, except the bounty exception below.

clamp_applied.description: bounty_exception applies only when I >= 0.85 AND contribution_type = AUDIT_CONTRIBUTION.

ZKPPassportDisclosure.title: What a passport discloses, and what it does NOT prove
ZKPPassportDisclosure.description: There is no zero-knowledge in zk RepID today. The sole production IBindingScheme (PendingPoseidon2Scheme) throws on all three methods; what ships is a COMMITMENT, not a proof.

commitment.description: A reproducible commitment over the disclosed fields. NOT a proof, and the field name must not imply one.

proven.description: PERMANENTLY false until Poseidon2 parameters land — a cross-lane decision. A schema that permitted true here would let a commitment be published as a proof, which is the exact substitution the zkp attestation work removed.

witness_hidden.description: Policy status.blocked lists witnessHidden, and promote.cannot_promote bars it. Nothing hides a witness today.

proof_system.description: Explicitly null. This field once carried 'groth16' over a SHA-256 of a timestamp.

disclosed_axes.description: Selective disclosure: which of the five axes this passport reveals.

withheld_axes.description: Named rather than omitted, so a verifier can tell 'withheld' from 'absent'.

bft_on_passport.description: composite.bft_on_passport. BFT contributes zero weight; 0 rows have ever been evaluated.

X402GateDecision.title: An x402 spend decision gated by effectiveAuthority
X402GateDecision.description: A_eff = min(R_route, 100 * sqrt(S_usd)) * 1[builder >= 500]. The contracted-pay gate is a SEPARATE mechanism (authority.pay_gate_is_not_a_term).

decision.description: Three outcomes. NOT_CHECKED is not an allow — a gate that could not evaluate has not passed.

not_checked_reason.description: Required whenever decision is NOT_CHECKED. Silence here is how an unevaluated gate reads as a pass.

r_route.description: Routing RepID. MUST be r_route and never r_ledger while sigma = 1, or A_eff rises because decay was latent.

stake_usd.description: S_usd; the anti-whale term is 100 * sqrt(S_usd).

binding_term.description: Which term actually bound the decision. Without this, a denial cannot be explained to the agent it denied.

x-unspecified: The wire encoding and transport for these events. The policy file does not state one.
The mapping from agent_id to repid_agents.id — recorded as an OPEN blocker, no DID mapping exists.
repid_score_events.event_type does not currently contain any of these five literals; adding them is a CHECK-constraint DDL and a cross-lane vocabulary decision, not a code change.
